meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会根据 claude-mem 的时间线数据,为指定项目生成一份名为「Journey Into [项目]」的叙述报告,涵盖项目起源、架构演变、技术债、令牌经济等章节,并保存为 Markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求写时间线报告、分析项目历史或生成完整项目报告时触发。

say.text: 用 tokyo 项目的完整历史写一份 Journey 报告
say.note: 指定项目并生成叙述报告

say.text: 分析当前项目的开发历程,出一份时间线报告
say.note: 使用当前目录名作为项目名

say.text: 把项目全部历史总结成 Journey Into 报告,存到 reports 目录
say.note: 保存到自定义输出路径

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches the full timeline from claude-mem, analyzes it, and produces a narrative report titled "Journey Into [Project]" covering origins, architecture evolution, tech debt, token economics, etc., saved as a Markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, or a full project report.

say_en.text: Write a Journey report for the tokyo project's full history
Analyze the current project's development history and produce a timeline report
Summarize the whole history into a Journey Into report saved under reports/
